answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 15563 Country: India Title: Assalamualikum, We are into the business of Real Estate . can we give service for Alcohol beverage company Get them a house the commission what we get from them is it halal we are just giving the real estate services? Question: Assalamualikum, We are into the business of Real Estate . can we give service for Alcohol beverage company Get them a house the commission what we get from them is it halal we are just giving the real estate services? Answer ID: 15563 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1600D/203K=1430) You are allowed to provide the services if you do not tell lie and deceive and the commission amount is already agreed upon. According to one opinion, it is allowable to provide the service for an alcohol beverage company too and the income will be lawful, but according to another opinion, it is better to avoid. However, in any case the income will not be termed haram , but it will not be perfectly pure too. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
